about: Food values on RotN 3.3.4 (hunger, saturationModifier, saturation = hunger * saturationModifier * 2) and foods to avoid. A food a pack script sets (HungerTweaker, applied last) has the script's values, cited by line; any other food has Hunger Overhaul's (its vanilla table, or its divide rule with this pack's config). Built by tools/build-food-values.mjs from the pinned server pack zip; see that file for the method.

betterWithModsHCHunger.note: Better With Mods registers the event handlers of a feature only when the feature is enabled

evidence.order: HungerOverhaul-1.12.2-1.3.3.jenkins148.jar: FoodModifier.getModifiedFoodValues(FoodEvent$GetFoodValues) is @SubscribeEvent(priority = HIGHEST); HungerTweaker-1.12.2-1.3.0.jar: ModEventHandler.on(FoodEvent$GetFoodValues) is @SubscribeEvent(priority = LOWEST) and applies CTFoodValues (the scripts' foodValues) last
evidence.rule: HungerOverhaul FoodModifier.getModifiedFoodValues: returns unless Config.modifyFoodValues (bytecode 0-6); a blacklisted item keeps its values (7-20); lookupModifiedFoodValues (the table, matched with ItemStack.isItemEqual, so meta 0 for Item keys) wins (22-38); otherwise hunger = max(1, Math.round(hunger / foodHungerDivider)) (42-57) and saturationModifier = hunger / foodHungerToSaturationDivider when that is not 0 (62-83), then / foodSaturationDivider (88-91)
evidence.table: HungerOverhaul VanillaModule: FoodModifier.setModifiedFoodValues(Items.X, new FoodValues(hunger, saturationModifier)) for 19 vanilla foods when Config.useHOFoodValues (bytecode 50-53); setModifiedFoodValues(Item) keys new ItemStack(item), meta 0
evidence.cast: HungerTweaker ModEventHandler.on(FoodEvent$GetFoodValues): new hunger = (int) hunger.eval(old hunger) (Expression.eval then d2i, bytecode 91-96), so a script hunger of 0.1 gives 0; saturationModifier is a float
evidence.saturation: AppleCore FoodValues: the saturation a food adds is hunger * saturationModifier * 2 (vanilla FoodStats.addStats), capped at the food level

notReflected: IMC from other mods to Hunger Overhaul (its table and blacklist); hungerOverhaulImc lists the classes that name it
Hunger Overhaul's HarvestCraft and Biomes O' Plenty tables: those mods' foods no script sets are in notComputed
per-player changes (FoodEvent$GetPlayerFoodValues listeners, e.g. diminishing returns) and the food level cap on saturation
